subject: Tensor Weekly #142: small models, long context, and the agent eval mess
body:
This week: a 3B open-weights model that holds 1M tokens of context, why agent benchmarks disagree with each other, and a practical guide to distillation on a single GPU. Plus: 5 papers worth your weekend.

Read in browser · Unsubscribe
